name: bg-laws runner wrappers pass --no-commit-report on vm700
description: vm700 incident 2026-08-31: the 06:10 incremental crashed in commitReport (pipeline deviation #79 — bare git commit, bglaws has no git user.email). The pipeline-side fix makes the commit succeed with the pipeline identity, but on vm700 that would be worse: bglaws cannot push the public pipeline repo, so every report commit would diverge /opt/bg-laws/pipeline from origin and wedge the worker-tick `git pull --ff-only` self-update (spec 80 §7) the moment origin advances. The deployed wrappers therefore pass the spec'd --no-commit-report flag (spec 50 §2 stage 8: files written, no commit): backfill.sh.j2 and incremental.sh.j2. Reports stay on disk untracked; admin build still reads them.

implementation.changes: roles/bg-laws/templates/incremental.sh.j2 and roles/bg-laws/templates/backfill.sh.j2: append --no-commit-report to the `run incremental` / `run backfill` invocations, with a comment naming pipeline deviation #79 and the ff-only self-update hazard

checks: ansible-playbook playbook-index.yaml -l vm700 --tags bg_laws — templates land changed
vm700: sudo -u bglaws git -C /opt/bg-laws/pipeline status --short shows no staged reports; worker-tick pull stays ff-only clean
